description: Create a payment link anyone can pay in USDC. It pays your verified wallets from Studio Settings > Wallets. Needs an access token with mcp:products:write. Moves no money.

accessToken.description: Your Studio access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

chains.description: Which chains to accept. Default: every chain you have a verified wallet on

description.description: Optional details shown on the pay page

thank_you.description: Optional message the buyer sees after paying

title.description: What the payment is for, 2 to 120 characters

name: create_payment_link
